definitions.short: a kneading-trough (in which the dough rises)
definitions.full: H4863. mishereth [ מִשְׁאֶ֑רָת ] noun feminine a household vessel , AV(Exodus), RV kneading-trough ; vessel in which was dough before it was leavened ( Exod 12:34 ) (hence usually derived from שְׂאֹר leaven (with שׂ — by error? — for שׂ ), but this not certain; compare מַשְׂרֵת above); — only suffix מִשְׁאַרְתֶּ֑ךָ Deut 28:5 , 17 (both + טַנְאֲךָ ); plural suffix מִשְׁאֲרוֺתֶיךָ , Exodus 7:28 (J; + תַּנּוּרֶיךָ ), מִשְׁאֲרֹתָם Exod 12:34 (E). מְשֻׁבָה see מְשׁוּבָה . מִשְׁבְּצוֺת see שׁבץ מַשְׂבֵּר , [ מִשְׁבָּר ] see שׁבר . [ מִשְׁבָּת ] see שׁבת . מִשְׁגֶּה see שׁגה .
definitions.rootNote: from 7604 in the original sense of swelling ;
